high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for the movie "Crew," which is set to be released on March 29, 2024, on Netflix. The poster features a woman dressed as an airline flight attendant, wearing a red uniform with the word "CREW" prominently displayed on the back of her jacket. She has a blue headscarf tied neatly around her head and is looking over her shoulder towards the viewer with a confident expression. The background of the poster shows the interior of an airplane, with rows of seats visible, suggesting that the story might involve air travel or the aviation industry.
